'''Micah Forman''' is a Star Wars CCG player. They finished 55th in [[DecipherCon 1999 Japanese Sealed Deck]] at [[DecipherCon 1999]]<ref name="dc99sw23_1">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/SW23_1.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Scores: Japanese Sealed Deck], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010108184600/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/SW23_1.html Internet Archive]</ref>.
